title: Why American artist Mary Cassatt's legacy still resonates in France today
summary: In this edition we're pleased to welcome back Lauren Jimerson to discuss the Mary Cassatt exhibit entitled "The Choice of Independence" that's currently showing at the Musee d'Orsay in Paris.
